title: Lake chlorophyll-a monitoring priorities: code and data for multi-horizon risk ranking

creators.name: Luo, Siran
creators.affiliation: Department of Environmental Science and Engineering, Fudan University, Shanghai, China

creators.name: Zhang, Jibiao
creators.affiliation: Department of Environmental Science and Engineering, Fudan University, Shanghai, China

description:
Code, figure source tables and documentation for evaluating multi-horizon lake chlorophyll-a risk rankings under limited monitoring capacity. The external evaluation covers 2,844 lakes and 130 biweekly prediction dates during 2021–2025.

The executable workflow reproduces event-coverage evaluation and figures from stored predictions. The complete analysis inputs, stored predictions and fitted model artifacts are distributed in Analysis_Data_and_Models_v1.0.0.zip at GitHub release v1.0.0. The same release provides Code_and_Figure_Data_v1.0.0.zip and SHA256SUMS.txt.

Version 1.0.1 updates archival and citation metadata. Research code, data and results are unchanged from version 1.0.0.
